notes.title: Morkull hits the Summer Sale with a bang – 25% off!
notes.content:
HUMANS! Morkull, God of Death and master of sarcasm, speaks!

I have decided to show mercy and let you grab Morkull Ragast’s Rage with a glorious 25% off. 


Yes, even mortals like you deserve a taste of power (and pain) every now and then. No better moment to dive into the madness of my domain than during the Steam Summer Sale!

Since launch, countless brave (and not-so-bright) souls have dared to face my challenges. Some screamed. Some cried. A few actually laughed. And they all agreed on one thing: this game SLAPS. With chaotic 2D action, a pinch of old-school style, and my lovely voice constantly yelling at you – what more could you want?



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43122095/a710fab01a96da0885943cfc23a89580e1963612.png"]


The discount starts today at 7:00 PM CEST, and I won’t keep being this generous forever. So unless you want me to come knocking on your pathetic mortal door… GO GET IT!

notes.title: Morkull Ragast’s Rage - Update 1.0.7 & A Message from the God of Darkness
notes.content:
A message from your beloved god, Morkull

One time ago the video game Morkull Ragast's Rage (starring yours truly, the god of death and darkness himself) came out.
Some of you mortals have managed to get me to escape from this blissful videogame — I guess that’s why I’m writing this.
And in case you haven’t… maybe it’s time to stop browsing this page and finally add it to your library.

Anyway, I want to say THANK YOU to all the people who have played it.
I will have no choice but to have pity on the kitty (inside joke for those who have played it, hehe).

Version 1.0.7 - Update & Fixes

Now I have my developers working and paying special attention to your feedback to give you the best experience possible.
Be patient though… they’re only three mere humans and I can’t give them any more whiplash (believe me, I’ve tried).

In the meantime, for the most clueless, here’s what the latest patch includes:


Enemy ‘Bat’: Reduced damage applied by these enemies.
Key: Changed position of the key obtained after the rolling rocks in ‘Purple Mile’.
Laser Balance: Reduced the number of laser traps in ‘The Retreat’ area.
Death Penalty: Reduced from 50% to 25%.
Various minor bug fixes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43122095/e08a165f9a44828c5ea0e27bfecc267d6ad33e05.png

Support my tyranny (with a positive review)

If you liked Morkull Ragast's Rage, I encourage you to leave your POSITIVE REVIEW.
You can't imagine how much it helps my boys — and despite months of starvation, they still dream of eating again someday (how weak humans are).

Help me spread evil, atrocities, and tyranny all over the world!
Signed by the most infamous god: Morkull.
Kisses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43122095/e6713a7b89f5c32c4f763043877dbaec81877806.png

notes.title: Morkull: Ragast’s Rage is here!
notes.content:
"Finally! You have no idea how long I’ve waited for this moment… and now YOU HAVE NO EXCUSE. PLAY!" 

Listen carefully, mortal. Today is the day.
Morkull: Ragast’s Rage is now available on Steam.
You can keep pretending you didn’t see me, you can look the other way… but deep down, you know you’ll fall sooner or later.

This hand-drawn action-platformer Metroidvania is not like the others. Why?
Because I am not like the others.

💀 Ragast breaks the fourth wall… and your patience.
🕹️ Explore a dark, brutal world filled with traps, creatures, and impossible challenges.
🔥 Unlock new powers and use your rage to carve your way through the shadows.
🧩 Face puzzles, platforming, and secret areas that will test your wit.
🎭 You’re not just playing… you’re becoming my toy.

This is not your typical Metroidvania. This is my world. My rules. My fun.

 The chaos begins NOW! 
📅 Now available on Steam
🛒 Add it to your library and come challenge me… if you dare.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191540/

[strike]Or keep ignoring me…[/strike] but don’t say I didn’t warn you.

notes.title: Add Morkull to your Wishlist now! (Announcement Trailer)
notes.content:
Get ready to play as Morkull, the villain of this story, who knows he is a character in a video game, knows the existence of a player who controls him (i.e. you) and some developers who have created him (i.e. us).

Your objective? To help Morkull escape from the Ragast so that he can rule and carry out his evil plans all over the world. Yes, that's right, your typical cliché villain....


 Art and animation - "Morkull Ragast's Rage" is completely hand-drawn and animated, frame by frame. Inspired and influenced by traditional animated films and other two-dimensional video games. This traditional animation endows the entire cast of characters with great naturalness and life.

[previewyoutube=B1h-w1ImzLk;full][/previewyoutube]

 Breaking the fourth wall - What makes the game special is Morkull himself, his personality and character, along with that breaking of the fourth wall that allows him to talk to the players as if he were right there. We have endowed Morkull with great charisma and personality, constantly generating a lighthearted atmosphere loaded with constant humor, bad jokes and pop culture references.

 Combat system - You'll have your own hands and all the power that comes with being the God of Death and Darkness, of course... Plus, a wide selection of combos and abilities that will allow you to fight in the deepest corners of the Ragast.


Morkull Ragast's Rage will be available for PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series and PlayStation 5.
